name: Risk Tolerance Questionnaire & IPS
summary: A two-part risk tolerance questionnaire that generates a regulator-ready Investment Policy Statement.
description: Clients rank life-risk categories and answer questions about their actual behavior during past market downturns. The advisor adds a few capacity inputs, and the app generates a branded, exam-ready Investment Policy Statement matching the firm's existing IPS template.

dataIngressDeclarations.purpose: Store the client's name, email, and questionnaire answers, plus the advisor's capacity inputs, as an app-scoped PlannerXchange data record so the two-part flow can be completed across separate sessions and an Investment Policy Statement can be generated from it.
dataIngressDeclarations.retention: Persisted via PlannerXchange's app-data store for this app's installation; not written to any builder-owned database or third-party service.
